source_range: 1 Thessalonians 1:1–5:28; 2 Thessalonians 1:1–3:18; 1 Timothy 1:1–6:21; 2 Timothy 1:1–4:22; Titus 1:1–3:15; Philemon 1:1–1:25; Hebrews 1:1–6:20; reconsideration of18 earlier Matthew/Luke/Acts/Romans units
peer_review_resolution: Every retained pair received a second AI-assisted source/target comparison. Findings and resolutions are preserved in the peer records; this is not independent human specialist approval.
source_book_order_policy: Resume 1Thessalonians1:1 and follow the exact canon order and divisions. Prepare each complete book inventory only after every original of the previous book has been read, then read all originals in the current source book before advancing to the next. Carry unresolved deferrals separately without credit; later-book target/context readings do not open source review. The computed next_unreviewed is the exact continuation.

source_book_boundary.method: Complete source inventories are prepared after the previous canonical book all-originals-read boundary andbefore opening the new source book. Source-only and inventory preparation earn zero completion credit. Everyretainedtarget must subsequently be actuallyread andindependently compared. Hebrewsiscuratedonlythrough6:20;notall303originalunitswere read.
source_book_boundary.count_basis: Original-unit counts refer to SOURCE REVIEW roles. Retained-target/context reads in a later pending source unit earn zero source review/completion credit and do not move next_unreviewed.

target_policy: User-specified hourly target: 500 newly completed distinct source verses with passage-supported cross-references. A source verse counts once irrespective of its number of retained target passages. Deferred and previously completed source verses earn zero new-source completion credit; pair totals are separate.
review_scope: Initial AI-assisted supplied-English passage review. Source/target wording and numbering are pinned; independent specialist and live destination checks remain pending.

auxiliary_review_evidence.purpose: Preserved reading and draft-comparison evidence; final counts derive only from the final proposals and peer outcomes.
